question: Is the near-zero Delta_mask an artifact of pooling only the sampled questions' own evidence, or a property of the displaced evidence?
design: Answer coverage before and after the per-query mask, split on whether the mask changed the context set, plus what the displaced and substituted passages carried.
verdict: INERTNESS: the displaced passages were largely not answer-bearing, so there was little for the mask to remove.
reading: 7.9% of displaced passages carried the gold span against 6.3% of their substitutes.
